permissionsAndNativeReview.sourceReviewMapping: These review commits are not proven to build selected releases. Binary bytecode/metadata is authoritative for audited behavior.
permissionsAndNativeReview.c2me: Nested native math includes linux-x86_64.so and windows-x86_64.dll. Windows native loaded in standalone control. No ARM native found.
permissionsAndNativeReview.spark: Windows async-profiler unavailable; Java sampler saved locally. No allocation/native-profiler claim.
permissionsAndNativeReview.zfastnoise: Nested zfastnoise-ocl inventoried. OpenCL acceleration not proved active; no Android/OpenCL claim.

simple-voice-chat.assessment: All Rights Reserved. FAQ permits credited modpack inclusion; modified-fork redistribution permission is not established. Desktop ARM natives do not prove Android/Bionic support. Java clients need voice integration; Geyser does not supply Bedrock voice.

geyserVersions.observed: Bedrock 26.0-26.45 / Java 26.2 at audit; no real Bedrock client tested.
